items.title: Blackstone (BX) Joins Global AI Infrastructure Funding Alliance With Major Financial Firms
items.summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) has entered a new partnership with NVIDIA and major financial institutions to fund global AI infrastructure platforms. The alliance is focused on creating large scale compute financing platforms to support growing demand for AI focused data centers and related infrastructure. items.title: Blackstone’s Link Logistics Leases More Warehouse Space to Data-Center Suppliers
items.summary: The race to build artificial-intelligence infrastructure is fueling demand for new warehouses.  Warehouse developer and operator Link Logistics said 15% of new leasing so far this year is tied to the data-center buildout, up sharply from a year earlier.  Luke Petherbridge, chief executive of the Blackstone-owned company, said tenants include companies assembling and supplying components such as turbines, generators and switchgear.
